_comment: Rust crates that a wasm scan cannot see: (1) vendored forks, whose source directory name is in the binary but whose version is not, and (2) crates that compiled with no panic path and so left no `registry/src/<crate>-<version>/` string. Presence of every fork is verified against the binary by `gen:sbom-versions:check`; versions here are read from the pqctoday-hsm sources at `commit` (rust/Cargo.lock and each fork's Cargo.toml). The check fails unless `commit` equals the hsmCommit that public/wasm/wasm-provenance.json records for `bundle`, so rebuilding the engine forces this file to be re-read. Licenses come from each crate's own Cargo.toml.
